items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: I played there with Octia. ... Me, Ernest Rubelow, and Octia.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Okay. And then did you play many more? Let's see, we've got September the 4th, Gulfport.
I played there with Octia. Mm-hmm. Octia Crosby. Mm-hmm.
And then October the 17th, the Harmony Inn.
